reviews.title: Issues
reviews.text: Not maintained very well. Some episodes not publish, or they put the newest episodes at the bottom of the list of episodes so you have to scroll down to the bottom. Worst of all I am listening to an episode and the sound of a different episode starts playing also. You have to get completely out of the app and go back into it, find your episode again and hope it doesn’t happen again

reviews.title: Ad delivery platform
reviews.text:
The app does what any modern browser will block: tracking, ads, tracking, and more ads. 

There is no reason anyone without dementia should use Fox apps. Just use your subscription to watch in a browser.

reviews.title: Schemers
reviews.text: They make it very difficult to delete your account by rerouting you between their different subscription options. Frustrating and difficult to maneuver. Enough to make you give up and keep your subscription for a little while longer. Manipulation at its finest.

reviews.title: Fox sucks
reviews.text: Since they are showing their true colors by firing Maria, they have lost all credibility.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text: This app you cannot cancel. They automatically take your money

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Server issues, connectivity issues, uneven uploads, lost episodes, challenging UI, and now… they added commercials to their paid subscription… yeah that’s the last straw

reviews.title: Why does it not hold place???
reviews.text: Please install ability to keep your place when you stop watching

reviews.title: BEWARE
reviews.text: You will get kicked out of your subscription and no amount of reinstalling will work. You won’t get a refund either.

reviews.title: Very Deceptive
reviews.text: Fox nation said, “ thank you for your service here’s a free year subscription “ or so I thought. I redeemed my subscription successfully, then was prompted to download the app to use it on my tv, then I was charged for the app. So, even if I wasn’t a veteran, that means I would’ve had to pay twice for a single year subscription. I cannot stand false advertisement especially when it’s geared to take advantage of veterans. I would not have agreed to the “FREE” year subscription for veteran status for this app if it’s not truly free. I would like my money back that I didn’t agree to spend. F me for my service right?

reviews.title: American Offer for $17.76 for a year
reviews.text: If you have Fox one already do not bother with this offer. I chose it yesterday and it completely changed my Fox one account and wouldn’t let me access it.

reviews.title: Get Your Developers to Work on This Immediately
reviews.text: Desktop and mobile work, but the tv app is garbage. The tv app doesn’t work at all, which means no casting to it. Fix this immediately. TV app login doesn’t work. I tried multiple TVs but not one allows me to login with my account. The QR code the TV app provides doesn’t even work to login.

reviews.title: Frustrated subscriber
reviews.text:
Changed tv and can not activate my subscription 
Support is nonexistent chat and phone connections keep disconnecting 
Trying for two weeks to connect 
Will unsubscribe if I can ever get thru to do it

reviews.title: Too many ads !!
reviews.text: Why do you have so many ads? You paid a subscription. Live TV I understand, but trying to watch past shows is a pain . I like the shows, but thinking about just leaving. Maybe put the ads in the beginning and not in the middle of the shows

reviews.title: Cancellation takes 1 year- Buyer Beware
reviews.text: Cancelled same day billed $71.xx renewal.  They cancelled effective 1 year later & refused refund.

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: Do not purchase if you are hoping to WATCH the daytime line ups. Only audio is available for most. You will need to also purchase the FoxOne app to WATCH those videos. Which is very expensive.

reviews.title: Can’t log in
reviews.text: I have two days left on my subscription, but it will not let me login until I renew it for another month

reviews.title: News side good: Money gouging awful
reviews.text: Fox One and Fox Nation are the worst thieves in the App Store, in my opinion. Misleading descriptions, making you think if you buy their app, you’ll get the programs you want to see. Free trials end up not happening. You have to buy just one more app ( and the “Fox One” name itself is intentionally deceptive. Implying “One” is all you need. It isn’t. Stay away!

reviews.title: Subtitle Problems
reviews.text: The subtitles are always delayed and never line up with actual audio. This has become such a problem for our family and exists across all platforms, app, TV app, cable. I will not be continuing my subscription that just ended, the technology has already fixed this issue but FOX continues to use antiquated substitute/caption technology. This just seems so weird because a huge portion of FOX viewers need subtitles.

reviews.title: I wish I had better things to say
reviews.text: I’ve always liked Fox but after switching to Fox Nation(after canceling cable), it’s not user friendly. If you cancel early you don’t get your full service. I’d love to stand behind them but I have no reason to after the way I’ve been treated. I’m also forced to create a nickname to submit this, why?
